title: /sail's SKILL.md calls the sweep before /chart, or a tooth reds
intention: A tooth reds when skills/sail/SKILL.md stops calling skills.sail.sweep, or calls it after the /chart step, so the clean-start ruling (8t/8w) cannot be silently dropped from the skill text that is /sail's only wiring.
why: /sail's clean-start sweep (rulings 8t/8w, built by 92e0d158b1bc) runs only because SKILL.md tells the model to run it; nothing reds if that line is dropped or moved after /chart, so the clean start could vanish silently. Akien cleared the tooth verbatim: 8y 'lgtm' (/home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md line 433).
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy): /sail's sweep runs only because SKILL.md tells the model to run it; a tooth over the text makes dropping or reordering that step a red instead of silent drift. Also Law 9 (red is the default; the step is unguarded today).
how: Add one tooth to skills/sail/proofs/test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.py (PROVES clause for this ticket): read skills/sail/SKILL.md, find the first line invoking `python3 -m skills.sail.sweep` and the line of the '## 0. Chart it' heading; assert the sweep line exists and precedes the /chart heading. Prior art for skill-text teeth: skills/challenge/proofs/test_challenge_wiring.py and skills/intent/proofs/test_intent_skill.py read SKILL.md the same way. Questions a Haiku-level builder would need, answered here: Which file? skills/sail/proofs/test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.py only. Which PROVES key? add '<this ticket id>': {'1': 'test_skill_md_sweeps_before_it_charts'} beside the 92e0 block. How to find the sweep line? first line containing 'python3 -m skills.sail.sweep'. How to find /chart? first line starting with '## 0. Chart it'. What does the tooth assert? a pure helper _sweep_order_problem(text) -> str|None returns None for the live SKILL.md, 'absent' when no sweep line, 'after /chart' when the sweep line index > the chart heading index, 'no /chart heading' when the heading is missing; the tooth asserts None on the live text and the two mutation strings on scratch-built mutations of it. Must the build touch SKILL.md or sweep.py? No. Is the proof hermetic? yes — reads SKILL.md via the proof's own _REPO_ROOT, mutations are in-memory strings.

watchme: none, because the live signal is the seal itself: the tester's reseal on every commit touching skills/sail reruns this proof (skills/sail/validations/test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.json), and an edit dropping or reordering the sweep reds that seal and raises seal-red-skills-sail
gates_bound: Proved: skills/sail/proofs/test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.py green and sealed under bin/cairn test --netns, the new tooth under PROVES for this ticket; the tooth's in-proof mutations (sweep line deleted, sweep line after /chart) each red the predicate; the hollow reading is Akien's approval of the proofs-only build per ruling 8p (hollow.py:1100). Feeds back to origin on failure (a red returns the boat to FIXME).

decisions.text: D1: the proof carries TWO teeth keyed to the falsifier's clauses (proof_coverage.clauses returns ['1','2']): PROVES['41202d4c8d3b'] = {'1': 'test_skill_md_calls_the_sweep', '2': 'test_skill_md_sweeps_before_it_charts'}, committed red in 9154af40 (validate refuses an undeclared clause). Tooth 1 asserts _sweep_order_problem(live SKILL.md) is None and returns 'absent' with every line containing 'python3 -m skills.sail.sweep' removed; tooth 2 asserts the same None and returns 'after /chart' with that line moved directly below the '## 0. Chart it' heading, and 'no /chart heading' with that heading removed. The build is ONLY the helper _sweep_order_problem(text) -> str|None added to the same proof file: None when the first sweep-call line's index precedes the first line starting '## 0. Chart it'; 'absent' when no line contains the sweep call; 'no /chart heading' when the sweep line exists but no heading does; 'after /chart' otherwise. No assertion in either tooth changes in the build. The builder_check's single key 'test_skill_md_sweeps_before_it_charts' is superseded by this line.
decisions.step: unlisted: one PROVES key vs two falsifier clauses

decisions.text: D2: the proof is plain pytest functions with bare assert statements, run by the file's existing runner (if __name__ == '__main__': raise SystemExit(print_teeth_main(__file__)), already at the end of the file) — follow the five 92e0d158b1bc teeth in the same file. _sweep_order_problem is a module-level function placed after the _SKILL_MD/_SWEEP_CALL/_CHART_HEADING constants (lines 39-41 in 9154af40), uses those constants, imports nothing new; it iterates text.splitlines() with enumerate, takes the index of the first line containing _SWEEP_CALL and of the first line that startswith _CHART_HEADING, and returns 'absent' / 'no /chart heading' / 'after /chart' / None in that order of checks.

D3: after the build is committed, the proof is green under bin/cairn test --netns, and the ticket has crossed PROVEME, take the hollow reading: bin/cairn test --netns --seal --hollow 41202d4c8d3b skills/sail/proofs/test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.py. Because the build touched only the proof, the hollow skips it as the instrument and, per ruling 8p (cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py:1100-1110), prints 'ASKED Akien -> open-<id>'; once Akien answers approving, re-run the same command, which prints 'APPROVED ... -> open-<id>' and lands evidence.hollow['41202d4c8d3b'] on the seal. PROVED crosses only after that.

decisions.text: D4: the three constants ALREADY STAND in the proof file, committed by the red proof 9154af40 — _SKILL_MD = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / 'SKILL.md', _SWEEP_CALL = 'python3 -m skills.sail.sweep', _CHART_HEADING = '## 0. D5: if Akien's answer to the 8p question declines the proofs-only build, the hollow stays red and the ticket does not cross PROVED: it retreats PROVEME->BUILDME, and the decline is folded onto the ticket as a decision line before anything is rebuilt. If he approves, re-run the D3 command and PROVED crosses on its evidence.

D6: the D3 wait is not polled and not guessed. The first --seal run prints one line 'ASKED Akien -> open-<12hex> (cairn question list): once answered, re-run --seal' — copy that id, send it to the peer akiendelllinux_cc_0, and end the turn (no waiter, no loop). Akien's answer is detected by running cairn question show open-<12hex>: it prints the question's JSON, and it is answered exactly when that JSON carries "resolved": true and a non-empty "answer" (his verbatim words) with "answered_by" naming him. An approving answer → re-run the D3 command; the hollow itself re-reads the question (hollow.approval, hollow.py:731) and prints 'APPROVED skills/sail/proofs/test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.py -> open-<12hex>' — that printed line, not the builder's reading of his words, is what lands the evidence. If the re-run prints ASKED again (the hollow did not accept the answer as approval), treat it as a decline under D5.
